name: Winsol Engineers Ltd.
summary: Winsol Engineers Ltd. operates in the renewable energy sector, specializing in wind and solar power projects. The company provides comprehensive engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning (EPCC) services, which encompass site evaluation, resource assessment, feasibility analysis, design, and construction of both wind and solar power plants. Additionally, Winsol Engineers offers Balance of Plant (BoP) solutions, including high-voltage infrastructure such as electrical substations and transmission lines, connecting power generation to the grid. The company also delivers operation and maintenance (O&M) services to ensure the sustained performance and longevity of renewable energy installations, covering routine and corrective maintenance, performance monitoring, and system upgrades. Furthermore, Winsol Engineers acts as an Independent Power Producer, developing and operating renewable energy projects. Its primary operational footprint is concentrated in India, particularly in the renewable energy hubs of Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Maharashtra, serving major independent power producers and original equipment manufacturers.
